correctness.rationale: For every nondegenerate triangle, face-activity conditions are exact scalar products. When obtuse at A, three bases (B,C,BC) always contribute; exactly one of the other two side-foot conditions must hold, and A contributes iff both hold, yielding exactly 4 or 6. The high-count set is a triangle whose base proportion on BC is the positive Gram determinant over the claimed denominator. Algebraic substitution and factorization prove the sharp fixed-angle unique equality case and endpoint limits. The independent standard-library exact-rational checker passes 2715 face-count and parameter checks; the analytical proof covers all real parameters.

value.rationale: The exact probability law addresses Santaló’s natural mean-normal observable on the whole family of Euclidean triangles and supplies a complete classification of the obtuse regime left qualitative by Proposition 9 of arXiv:2406.01773. It locates the high-multiplicity region geometrically, establishes its exact area, and proves a natural unique fixed-angle isosceles extremal principle with a quantitative square-deficit identity. It is neither a numerical sample nor an isolated arbitrary parameter slice.
